Frames, sills and sash bars are real pieces standing off the wall, material trim, painted one color here.

By day a pane is dark glass with the sky in it; windows_lit glows at night with the room behind (its emission map, at full strength for the game's clock to scale). 22 triangles of generated glass became 22.
